maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new equipment (mowers, sweepers, vacuum trucks, snow removal) to municipalities and contractors; parts and service are a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are municipalities plus contractors, utilities and agricultural users; the government share is substantial but likely under half.

serial_acquirer.reason: Has bought many brands over decades, but growth is mainly organic equipment sales, with occasional bolt-on acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Sells vehicle-mounted and tractor equipment that buyers can replace with competitors' machines; switching is a fleet purchasing decision, not a qualification issue.

notes: Government share of revenue is uncertain; municipal sales are large but not clearly most.
